title: Protocol for Differentiation of Human iPSCs into Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cells
protocol: Recoat plates for iPSC culture with Geltrex™ matrix.
Thaw Geltrex™ matrix in a refrigerator at 2 to 8°C for 16–20 hours.
Pipette up and down gently during thawing to avoid air bubbles.
Dilute Geltrox™ matrix at 1:100 in pre-chilled (4°C) DMEM/F-12.
Add sufficient diluted Geltrox™ solution to cover the entire growth surface area of plates.
Incubate coated plates at 37°C for a minimum of 60 minutes.
Store coated dishes wrapped with parafilm at 4°C for up to two weeks.
Keep the coated surface moist by adding enough media (1.5–2 mL per well) to avoid drying.
Work with Geltrox™ on ice during all aliquotting and plating steps to prevent premature gelling.
Allow plates to equilibrate at room temperature (20-25°C) for 1 hour before use.
Aspirate off the supernatant above the Geltrox™ matrix coating.
Plate cells immediately in pre-equilibrated cell culture medium.
Aspirate media from iPSC cultures.
Add 1 mL of ReLeSRTM and incubate for 30 seconds.
Remove ReLeSRTM and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Add 2 mL of mTESR1 media to the dish.
Tap the dish gently to release iPSC colonies as aggregates.
Replate the aggregates in fresh mTESR1 per well in a new GeltrexTM-coated well of a 6-well plate.
Prepare extracellular matrix (ECM) solution in PBS on ice.
Mix fibronectin, laminin, and collagen IV to create ECM solution.
Add 150 μL of ECM solution to the apical side of each Transwell filter.
Incubate ECM-coated Transwell filters at room temperature for 16–20 hours.
Aspirate the ECM solution from Transwells after incubation.
Wash Transwells twice with 1× PBS and once with autoclaved Milli-Q water.
Store coated Transwells at room temperature or 4°C, sealed with parafilm, up to a week.
Remove mTeSR from the iPSC colonies.
Wash cells gently with PBS.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 500 μL of room temperature (20–25 °C) Accutase.
Incubate at 37°C for 2–3 min (max).
Collect cells by gently dissociating with a 5 mL pipette into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 180 × g (1,000 rpm) for 5 min.
Resuspend in mTeSR1 containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor and count the cells (1 μL per 4 ml mTESR1).
Prepare Transwells by adding mTeSR1 containing ROCK inhibitor to the desired number of wells.
Add 350 μL of mTeSR1 with ROCK inhibitor in the bottom chamber and 150 μL in the Transwell for 24 well inserts.
Count cells and add 150K live cells to each 6.5 mm Transwell.
Incubate at 37°C for 20–24 h.
Prepare Medium B by adding Wnt-3a (25 ng/mL) and Activin A (100 ng/mL) to pre-warmed RPMI medium.
Gently aspirate mTeSR1 medium from the basal side of the Transwells using a 200 μL pipette.
Add 350 μL of Medium B to the basal side of each Transwell without touching or disturbing the cells.
Carefully aspirate mTesR1 medium from the apical side of the Transwells.
Add 150 μL of Medium B into the apical side of each 6.5 mm Transwell, ensuring media is added to the edge of the Transwell.
Incubate at 37°C for 24 hours.
Prepare Medium C by adding FBS (1%) and Activin A (100 ng/mL) to pre-warmed RPMI medium.
Gently aspirate Medium B from the basal side of the Transwells using a 200 μL pipette.
Add 350 μL of Medium C to the basal side of each Transwell without touching or disturbing the cells.
Aspirate Medium B from the apical side of the Transwells.
Add 150 μL of Medium C into each 6.5 mm Transwell.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Remove and replace the Medium C with 350 μL of Medium D on the basal side of the Transwells.
Aspirate Medium C from the apical side of the Transwells.
Add 150 μL of Medium D into each 6.5 mm Transwell.
Incubate at 37°C for 24 hours.
Fix Transwells in 4% (vol/vol) paraformaldehyde for 1 hour at 4°C.
Wash 3 times with PBS.
Permeabilize in 0.5% Triton X-100 for 1 hour at 4°C.
Block for 1 hour with commercial CAS block.
Incubate in primary antibody diluted in CAS block at the required dilution at 4°C for 16–20 hours.
Wash 3 times in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS.
Incubate for 1 hour in secondary antibodies diluted in CAS block at a 1:500 dilution.
Wash 3 times in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS.
Add DAPI (1 μg/mL) and incubate for 5 minutes.
Wash 3 times with PBS.
Mount on glass microscope slides in Immunomount.
Prepare Medium E by adding FBS (2%), SB431524 (500 nM), and BMP-4 (5 ng/mL) to pre-warmed cSFDM medium.
Remove and replace the Medium D from the basal side of the Transwells with 350 μL of Medium E.
Carefully aspirate Medium D from the apical side of the Transwells and add 150 μL of Medium E into each 6.5 mm Transwell.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Repeat steps from Day 5 until day 9, replacing medium as described.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Assay one well of cell culture for the continued presence of FOXA2 and SOX17 with immunofluorescence.
Prepare Medium F by adding FBS (2%), BMP-4 (5 ng/mL), FGF-2 (10 ng/mL), FGF-10 (10 ng/mL) and KGF (10 ng/mL) to cSFDM medium.
Aspirate the Medium E from the basal side of the Transwells.
Replace the aspirated volume with 350 μL of Medium F in the basal chamber.
Carefully aspirate Medium E from the apical side of the Transwells.
Add 150 μL of Medium F into each 6.5 mm Transwell.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Remove and replace the Medium F (350 μL in basal chamber, 150 μL in apical chamber).
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Repeat steps of removing and replacing Medium F until day 17.
Assay one well of cell culture for LP markers including NKX2.1, SOX2, and SOX9 using immunofluorescence.
Prepare Medium G complete with 10 μM DAPT on Day 17.
Add DAPT to Medium G on the day of use.
Aspirate and replace Medium F from the basal side of the cultures with 350 μL of Medium G.
Aspirate Medium F from the apical side of the cultures using a pipette tip manually.
Gently wash the apical side with 100 μL PBS and aspirate.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Aspirate and replace Medium G from the basal side of the cultures on day 19.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Repeat steps for maintaining cultures as needed.
Take one well of cell culture from each time point (days 5, 10, 13, 17, 21, 25, and 31) for mRNA expression analysis using qRT-PCR.
Isolate total RNA using the Qiagen RNA Easy Mini Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Aliquot 500 ng of RNA and proceed with DNase treatment as per the manufacturer’s protocol.
Prepare cDNA from the DNase-treated RNA aliquot using a Protoscript first strand synthesis kit.
Take 1 wells of cell culture at days 31, 60 and 91 for immunofluorescence staining.
Stain for all the PNEC markers – SYP, CHGA, ROBO2, PGP9.5 and ENO2.
Co-stain with VIM (vimentin) and EPCAM to characterize iPNECs.
Collect media from the basal chamber of the Transwells of day 91 cultures.
Perform ELISA using Human Enolase 2/Neuron-specific Enolase Quantikine ELISA Kit (R&D systems).
Measure secreted levels of neuron-specific enolase (ENO2).
